title: American National Spelling Bee in Morocco
markdown:
During the month of May 2023, we travelled to the north of Morocco to the first National American Spelling Bee of Morocco.  Yassmin Salma Taha is currently in the 6th Grade. She won 1st runner up place in the competition. It is being held to build comradery and continue collaborating with American schools across the Kingdom of Morocco.

The spelling bee was held at the Moroccan American Legation of Tangier. Yassmin has been doing Anglia Exams for the past 2 years and is working on her level C-1 Proficiency level currently.

American Group International and Anglia Morocco is very grateful for the opportunity to showcase our talent and we thank the American School in Tangier for inviting us. We would personally like to thank Francesca Ghi, coordinator of the event and Michael Prada, Principal of the American School of Tangier.
